name: mindart
description: A project-local image genealogy canvas for combining reference images and prompts through MCP Apps.

interface.shortDescription: Build traceable image generations on a mind-map canvas.
interface.longDescription: MindArt organizes imported and generated images as a project-local genealogy tree. Combine a parent image with up to four cross-branch references, describe what to reuse from each image, and send the compiled image-plus-text request to the host model.
defaultPrompt: Open the MindArt canvas for this project.
